issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double, but the solution implementation declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning int. This creates a return-type mismatch and causes integer division (losing fractional students per tutor) which contradicts the specified API and expected numeric precision.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature and implementation consistent with the UML/specification by changing the solution's getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() to return double and perform floating-point division (e.g., return getTotalNumberOfStudents() / (double) getNumberOfTutors();). Alternatively, if integer result is intended, update the problem statement/UML to specify int and document integer division behavior.
